data.name: Weird Words
data.description: You can start a performance as a standard action, lashing out with %1 potent sounds, each sound affecting one target within 30 feet. These are ranged touch attacks. Each weird word deals 1d8+%2 points of damage (Fortitude DC %3 half), and the bard chooses whether it deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage for each word.|WeirdWordsAMount|WeirdWordsBonusDamage|WeirdWordsDC
